hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/daily_reports"; sfx="${DAILY_REPORT_SUFFIX:-}"; latest=$(ls "$d" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[0-9]{8}${sfx}\.md$" | sort | tail -1); if [ -n "$latest" ]; then echo "[Latest daily report: daily_reports/$latest]"; cat "$d/$latest"; day=$(printf %.8s "$latest"); others=$(ls "$d" | grep -E "^${day}(_[^.]*)?\.md$" | grep -vx "$latest" | tr "\n" " "); if [ -n "$others" ]; then echo "[Same-day reports by other agents (not loaded): $others]"; fi; else echo "[No daily report yet. Consider running /daily-report]"; fi

if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/knowledge/INDEX.md" ]; then echo "[Knowledge wiki index — load only the pages you need]"; cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/knowledge/INDEX.md"; else echo "[No knowledge wiki yet. Use /wiki to start accumulating distilled knowledge]"; fi

off="${REPORT_TZ_OFFSET_HOURS:-9}"; today=$(date -u -d "+${off} hours" +%Y%m%d); report="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/daily_reports/${today}${DAILY_REPORT_SUFFIX:-}.md"; if [ -f "$report" ]; then echo "" >> "$report"; echo "<!-- session ended: $(date -u -d "+${off} hours" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)+${off}h -->" >> "$report"; fi
